```plato

    // The local discrepancy of the box anchored at the region's minimum corner and
    // reaching to `corner`: how far the fraction of points inside it is from the
    // fraction of the area it covers.
    BoxDiscrepancy(corner: Point2D, region: Bounds2D, points: Array<Point2D>): Number
    {
        var area = RegionArea(region);
        var box = (corner.X - region.Min.X).Max(0.0) * (corner.Y - region.Min.Y).Max(0.0);
        var inside = points.Reduce(0.0, (n, p) =>
            n + (p.X <= corner.X && p.Y <= corner.Y ? 1.0 : 0.0));
        return points.Count <= 0 || area <= 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : (inside / points.Count.ToNumber - box / area).Abs;
    }
```
